QUOTE: By default that renames the member to `private_foo`, so `ctx->foo` no longer compiles from application code. ... `library/common.h:132` defines `MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS` unconditionally ... inside the library `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(x)` expands to plain `x`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that code defining the macro (the library, ssl_server2/ssl_client2) sees plain member names, while ordinary application code without it sees the `private_`-renamed members.
